theorems.statement: The frozen algebraic cut/incidence paths form a typed path-formal carrier whose evaluation to ordinary algebraic correspondence/cycle operations respects composition.

For the frozen J1/J3 theorem-critical future language, two path prefixes are equivalent exactly when their sets of ordinary source outcomes (validity, support, scheme multiplicity, X-cycle token) agree.
B_std_corr independently computes the same outcome kernel using ideal/intersection/cycle normal forms; therefore the Enterprise 83->19 quotient is source-inherited.
Route occurrence multiplicity and scheme intersection multiplicity are independent typed quantities; A2 gives one route with intersection multiplicity two.
